# VRG EV Execution Plan

## Where it stands

Twelve steps are tracked. Four are done, three are moving, two wait for sign-off and three have not started. This paragraph explains the plan and is not a task.

## The phases

Each phase is a stage the business passes through. A phase can start before the previous one is fully closed; the order is the order in which each becomes the critical path.

| Phase | What it covers | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Foundations | Company set-up, bank account, GST | ✅ Done |
| Sites | Leases and power for the first hubs | 🟡 In progress |
| Launch | Opening the first hub to riders | Not started |
